traffic_management.defaultSafety: Full structural/high-visibility PPE. Establish positive blocking apparatus positioning and sequential cone tapers prior to commencing work on roadway.

skills.name: Apparatus Positioning (Fend-Off Angle)
skills.description: Position apparatus at a 45-degree angle pointing away from the work zone to create a physical traffic barrier.

skills.name: Cone Taper & Buffer Zone Deployment
skills.description: Deploy sequential traffic cones to establish an active merge taper and a protected lane buffer.

forcible_entry.defaultSafety: Safety glasses and heavy leather gloves mandatory. Control tool leverage points to prevent slips and clear bystanders from swing radius.

skills.name: Inward-Swinging Door Forcing (The Irons)
skills.description: Properly gap, set, and force an inward-swinging door using a flat-head axe and Halligan bar.

vehicle_extrication.defaultSafety: Full structural PPE with eye protection and heavy rescue gloves. Disconnect 12V/high-voltage power sources, crib vehicle securely before tool operation.
resources: Hydraulic Spreader, Cutter, and Ram Kit

driving.defaultSafety: Seatbelts mandatory for all crew members prior to apparatus movement. Comply with local provincial traffic laws.

pumping.defaultSafety: Wear eye and hearing protection when operating high-pressure pump panels.

interior_operations.defaultSafety: Full structural PPE with SCBA fully donned and checked prior to entering IDLH atmosphere. Maintain team integrity (PAR checks).

command_operations.defaultSafety: Establish formal Incident Command Post (ICP) in a safe, visible location outside the immediate hazard zone.

technical_rescue.defaultSafety: Dual-path safety rope systems mandatory for all elevated or below-grade loads. Complete atmospheric monitoring.

dangerous_goods.defaultSafety: Approach upwind and uphill. Maintain safe isolation distances utilizing the Emergency Response Guidebook (ERG).

wildland_fire.defaultSafety: Wear certified wildland PPE (nomex, boots, helmets). Identify escape routes and safety zones (LACES protocol).
